human_demonstrations.episode_video_ranges_source: Actual per-episode LeRobot metadata, end-exclusive global MP4 frame ranges

data.robot_state_action_statistics: Computed independently per task from selected robot training rows only; development reuses training statistics

fixed_training_protocol.checkpoint_selection: Final update 6000 selected before evaluation; no selection or retraining on evaluation outcomes
fixed_training_protocol.constant_condition: Zero task/video condition, same architecture and robot data; no task ID supplied to the policy
fixed_training_protocol.frozen_human_backbone: DINOv2 ViT-L/14, generic pretrained weights, no LoRA

fixed_evaluation_protocol.success_definition: Official task success at final step, reported separately from success observed earlier
fixed_evaluation_protocol.monitoring: Action/physical observations are read-only; no added quality rejection or early termination

matched_comparison_checks.initial_policy_hash_scope: All non-task-encoder policy parameter and buffer names, types, shapes and values before optimizer updates

paired_initial_states.checked_arrays: All recorded S0 env_states arrays and initial public robot RGB/qpos; no requirement that subsequent policy trajectories match

offline_video_intervention.interpretation: Changing only the human video at a fixed saved development RGB/qpos observation measures input sensitivity and condition-cache restoration. A cross-task swap does not establish task-semantic necessity or effects on rollout success.

limitations: Two L0 source tasks with supervised Piper robot data; not the full TIG benchmark, held-out task transfer, or zero-shot embodiment transfer.
One training seed per condition and ten fixed evaluation seeds per task; the 60% versus 50% macro success rates are descriptive observations, not an established general video benefit.
The fixed 6000-update budget is an engineering pilot budget; convergence, optimal stopping and the cause of lower pill performance have not been established.
The two task scenes differ, so success and the offline video-sensitivity check do not by themselves show that video semantics are necessary.
Failure stages summarize sampled task predicates; they do not by themselves establish a unique physical cause.
Large checkpoints, videos, trajectories and raw world arrays are retained under the evidence root and are not embedded in this record.

data_audit.conclusion: No task-routing, train-only normalizer or padding error found; both tasks have a static prefix, which alone cannot establish the cause of failure.

offline_inference.method: Actual get_action with zero CVAE latent on real expert development public RGB/qpos; expert future actions are comparison targets only. Not posterior-conditioned training loss.
offline_inference.clip_intervention_scope: H31 episodes0-5 at the same development seed7000 initial observation; episode5 is already consumed test material and is not used for checkpoint selection.
offline_inference.interpretation: Later initial chunk queries predict more starting motion; similar first-frame outputs across six clips do not support an ep4-only explanation. Offline error does not establish rollout success.

execution_window_intervention.only_changed_factor: execute_steps 8 to16 on existing6000 checkpoints, same development seeds/human clip and original200-step horizon
execution_window_intervention.interpretation: Constant policy starts and places the right object in all3, while left loss/missed grasp prevents final success; both conditions remain0/3. Execution window contributes to stagnation. This does not prove the stationary prefix is causal or that16 is optimal.

next_training_plan.start: Fresh matched seed1 runs are the straightforward controlled option; current trainer has no exact-resume entry or complete mid-epoch/RNG recovery state.
next_training_plan.budget_reason: Double the pilot budget to test whether measured fitting and grasp-stage progress continue; not a convergence estimate.
next_training_plan.final_evaluation: Freeze fresh final cases after development selection; preserve all previous40 final cases unchanged.
